tagline: Leading tower operator connecting America through digital infrastructure
hero_kpi_rationale: Site rental revenue representing 95% of operating revenue, reflecting the company's core business model as the fifth-largest tower owner in the United States

kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from leasing space on towers to wireless carriers
kpis.description: Revenue generated from leasing space on towers to wireless carriers

kpis.name: Number of Towers
kpis.explanation: Number of towers owned by the company
kpis.description: Number of towers owned by the company across 19 states in the United States

kpis.name: Tower Tenancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Average number of tenant leases per tower, a key measure of portfolio utilization
kpis.description: Total number of tenancies (4,572) divided by total number of towers (4,450)

kpis.explanation: Book value of spectrum held by the company not subject to sale agreements
kpis.description: Book value of remaining spectrum not subject to pending sale agreements, primarily including C-Band spectrum

risks.title: T-Mobile Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on T-Mobile following the Master License Agreement and the wireless operations acquisition. Any failure by T-Mobile to meet its contractual obligations could have a significant impact on the business and financial results.

risks.title: Regulatory Approval Risks for Spectrum Transactions
risks.score_rationale: The spectrum sale transactions with Verizon, AT&T and T-Mobile remain subject to regulatory approval by the FCC and other customary closing conditions. Failure to complete these transactions could negatively impact the company's financial position.

risks.title: Competition in the Tower Industry
risks.score_rationale: Robust competition in the communications tower industry could limit the company's ability to increase tenancies and grow site rental revenue.

risks.title: Fixed Rate Escalator Risks
risks.score_rationale: Fixed rate escalators in long-term lease agreements could limit revenue growth and negatively impact operating results and cash flows.

risks.title: Land Rights and Ground Lease Risks
risks.score_rationale: Although 18% of the portfolio is located on land owned outright or with perpetual easements, the majority of towers (82%) are on leased land. Over 65% of towers on leased land have lease expirations of 10 years or more, but risks related to non-renewal or cost increases could impact operations.

risks.title: Weather-Related Event Risks
risks.score_rationale: Weather events and natural disasters could damage tower infrastructure and tenant equipment, impacting operations and financial results.

risks.title: Technological Advancement Risks
risks.score_rationale: Technological advancements such as satellite or alternative wireless technologies could reduce demand for traditional tower services, negatively affecting portfolio utilization and revenue.

ai_positioning.summary: The company does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
